High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Statement of facts/statement report on behalf of respondent no. 5 stands filed.
It has been submitted that pursuant to directions dated 13.11.2024, passed by this court the matter was taken up with the revenue authorities for acquisition of the land in question.

02. Today, learned counsel for respondent-Collector has produced before this court a copy of notification dated 28.12.2024, issued under Section 11(1) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thus it appeared that the respondents have initiated the process of acquisition of the land which is the subject matter of the present contempt petition.
03. The respondents are directed to expedite the process and the respondent-Collector shall file latest report with regard to the acquisition proceedings on next date of hearing.

04. List for consideration on 19.05.2025.
